_comment: App Store の英語（en-US）の説明文など。上限: name 30 字 / subtitle 30 字 / description 4000 字 / keywords 合計 100 字（カンマ込み）/ promotionalText 170 字。
name（名前）と subtitle（サブタイトル）は App 情報の項目で、ほかの項目とは別に App 情報の言語に書き込む。省略すると App Store Connect 側の値をそのまま残す。
米国・インドなど英語圏の利用者向けに書く（Issue #651）。日本語版の直訳にしない。サブタイトルとキーワードは、英語で検索される語（webhook / embed / bot / announcement など）を選ぶ。
「Discord」は商標なので名前・サブタイトルには入れない。キーワードと説明文では、現行の掲載で審査を通っているので使っている。
名前・サブタイトルにある語（ninja / cord / webhook / sender / embed / builder）は同じ言語の中で検索に使われるので、keywords には入れない。アプリ名とカテゴリ名ももともと検索対象なので入れなくてよい。
en-GB（インド向け）と es-MX（米国のキーワード枠）は、このファイルを extends で流用する。ここを変えるとそちらにも反映される。
promotionalText は省略できる（省略すると App Store Connect 側の値をそのまま残す）。
whatsNew は「このバージョンの最新情報」（上限 4000 字）。version が反映先のバージョンと一致するときだけ書き込む。リリースごとに version と text を書き換える。
name: Ninja Cord
subtitle: Webhook Sender & Embed Builder
promotionalText: Post to Discord as any name and avatar — no bot or code needed. Live embed preview, templates and broadcasts make server announcements and alerts quick from your phone.

whatsNew.text:
■ Fixes and improvements
• If you leave the message blank, the default text is now sent in your device's language ("Write something!" in English)
• An embed that only has empty field rows is no longer sent as an empty embed, and "How it looks on Discord" no longer shows an empty embed box for it
• If a webhook URL can't be read, the app now shows "URL format is invalid" instead of trying to send
• Improved the reliability of sending
• Moved the privacy policy to a new page

description:
Post to your Discord server from your iPhone or iPad — under any name, with any avatar. Ninja Cord sends messages through Discord webhooks, so there's no bot to code and no server to host. Just paste a webhook URL and post.

Perfect for server announcements, event reminders, match and raid call-outs, status updates and alerts for your community.

■ Post it your way
• Pick the sender name, avatar and message for each post
• Build embeds with a title and description, and see exactly how they'll look in Discord with the live preview
• Attach an image (up to 10 MB)
• Send an embed or an image on its own — no message text required

■ Built for regular posting
• Save webhook URLs with names and switch channels in one tap
• Save messages you post often as templates, then pin and reorder them
• See what went through in your send history (stored only on this device, and you can turn it off)
• Light, dark and automatic themes

■ Ninja Cord Pro (monthly auto-renewing subscription)
• No ads
• Unlimited templates (the free plan keeps up to 3)
• Full embeds: color, fields, image, thumbnail, footer and timestamp
• Broadcast the same message to several saved channels at once
Want to try before you subscribe? Watch an ad to use full embeds and broadcasting for one send (ad removal and unlimited templates are not included).

■ Get started in 3 steps
1. In Discord, open Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks for the channel you want to post to
2. Tap New Webhook, then Copy Webhook URL
3. Paste the URL into Ninja Cord and send
You need the Manage Webhooks permission on that server to create a webhook.

■ Good to know
• Anyone with a webhook URL can post to that channel, so keep your URLs private.
• Ninja Cord is not an official Discord app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord Inc.
